summary: Mr. Shekhar Bajaj ceased as Executive Chairman and was appointed Chairman Emeritus, while Mr. Sudarshan Sampathkumar was appointed Non-Executive Chairman.
quote: Cessation of Mr. Shekhar Bajaj (DIN: 00089358) as Executive Chairman and approve his continuation as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, and confer upon him the title of 'Chairman Emeritus'
